provenance: H. W. Kuhn (1950), 'A simplified two-person poker', Contributions to the Theory of Games I: game value -1/18 for the first player and the one-parameter equilibrium family.
Hand-computed best-response values; derivations in truth/README.md.

nash_family.description: alpha in [0, 1/3]. Seat 0: bet J=alpha, Q=0, K=3alpha; after check-bet call J=0, Q=alpha+1/3, K=1. Seat 1: after check bet J=1/3, Q=0, K=1; facing bet call J=0, Q=1/3, K=1.

hand_computed_best_responses.name: seat-1 station: always bets after a check, always calls a bet
hand_computed_best_responses.derivation: Bet is always called: J -2, Q 0, K +2. Check is always bet into: call same, fold -1. BR: J check-fold, Q 0, K +2 -> 1/3.

hand_computed_best_responses.name: seat-0 maniac: always bets
hand_computed_best_responses.derivation: Facing a bet: J fold -1, Q call 0, K call +2 -> 1/3.

hand_computed_best_responses.name: seat-1 folder: never bets after a check, folds every bet
hand_computed_best_responses.derivation: Bet every card; opponent folds; +1 always.
